title: Chapter 101: Mu Yang High School's Hidden Mission!
html:
The laptop’s speakers were quiet, but the crowd could hear every word. People turned toward Fei Youliang, still sprawled on the ground with foam at his lips, their expressions growing uncertain. Sensing public opinion turn against him, the middle-aged man hurriedly fast-forwarded.

A minute or two later, the footage showed Zhu Jianing and Fei Youliang entering the Haunted House. Curious about the attraction’s interior, visitors pressed closer for a glimpse of its layout and hidden mechanisms.

Built underground, the Mu Yang High School scenario was almost silent. The recorder captured the pair’s conversation clearly—including their plan to post a guide online and hire paid trolls to flood the Haunted House with bad reviews.

“So these people came here just to cause trouble?”

“We almost believed them earlier.”

Murmurs spread through the crowd. The middle-aged man had no choice but to skip ahead again.

The low light left the footage grainy. It showed only a dim corridor flanked by empty classrooms, but that alone was unsettling.

Qin Guang’s employees had not filmed the visit to promote Chen Ge. They wanted proof that he had ordered his staff to assault customers. Yet six minutes into the recording, it showed nothing but Fei Youliang and Zhu Jianing frightening themselves. Not a single employee appeared.

The studio staff grew uneasy while the visitors became more intrigued. In a Haunted House this large, not one actor played a ghost. So how did it scare anyone?

The footage soon reached the Pen Spirit game. When Fei Youliang asked his familiar question, Chen Ge nearly bit his tongue. At last he understood how the pair had enraged the spirit.

What followed was stranger still. Zhu Jianing abruptly released the pen and fled, while Fei Youliang scribbled furiously across the white paper.

“YOU WILL DIE! YOU WILL DIE! YOU WILL DIE!”

The visitors stared at the words in confusion.

“What is he doing?”

“A breakdown? Forget the park doctor—we should call a psychiatric hospital.”

“In other words, two of them entered the Haunted House, and one of them was scared dumb by his friend?”

Chen Ge released a long breath. Apart from the two victims, only he understood what had happened. The Pen Spirit must have appeared, but whether cameras could not capture it or the angle had simply missed it, the spirit itself was absent from the footage. What remained was eerie enough.

As the recording continued, Chen Ge leaned closer. This was the part he most wanted to see. Left alone after Zhu Jianing fled, Fei Youliang suddenly stopped writing.

The camera was pinned to his chest. For several seconds the image remained still, then tipped backward as Fei Youliang collapsed.

“No one touched him, right?”

“Yeah, so why did he faint?”

Ten seconds later, the camera moved. Fei Youliang had risen again.

He staggered out of the room, the image lurching violently as though he had forgotten how to walk. In all Chen Ge’s years of handling unconscious visitors, he had never seen one stand and walk away unaided.

The Pen Spirit had probably possessed him.

Chen Ge said nothing, but his eyes narrowed. Fei Youliang quickly adjusted to his body. Within seconds his pace increased and his gait became normal. When he reached the junction, Chen Ge and Zhu Jianing had just entered the restroom. They missed each other by moments.

The Pen Spirit was trying to escape the Haunted House?Chen Ge was spooked by the thought. If not for the incident that happened after this, the Pen Spirit might have successfully escaped.

Fei Youliang appeared to sense people inside the restroom. He slipped past it and hurried to the sealed classroom. With a clear purpose, he went to the last row and hugged one of the uniforms to his chest. As he turned to leave, he noticed the box containing the twenty-four name tags that Chen Ge had placed on the lectern.

As if recalling something terrible, Fei Youliang hurriedly emptied the tags onto the desk. He selected one, put it in his pocket, and ran for the exit. Before he reached it, the broken classroom door closed by itself.

Then came the strangest part of the recording. Fei Youliang turned and shouted at the empty classroom.

“I also treat this classroom as our home, but I have my reason to leave; I have to explain this to Wang Xin!

“Please let me go!

“I promise to come back after I’m done!

“Get away from me! I have to leave today! No one is going to stop me!”

Fei Youliang’s frantic screams poured from the laptop as he raged at the empty room.

“Let me go! Let me go!”

The camera shook, then fell as though torn loose in a struggle. From the floor, it framed Fei Youliang’s face perfectly. His expression changed with impossible speed, as if a dozen personalities were fighting for control of his body.

Several seconds later, his face went blank and the classroom door opened. Without a word, he retrieved the camera, fastened it to his chest, and walked like a puppet toward the deepest part of Mu Yang High School.

Chen Ge’s black phone vibrated. He quietly drew it out and took several steps back without looking away from the laptop.

While this unfolded, he had been in the corner restroom. Only one wall separated the rooms, yet he had heard nothing from the classroom. Once its door closed, the space inside seemed to slip into another dimension.

On-screen, Fei Youliang advanced stiffly toward the well. He climbed onto its rim and began speaking to himself.

“Are we going to jump?”

“I can understand Chen Yalin’s pain; she has her own reason.”

“If I were in her position, I believe I would do the same thing. After all, Wang Xin was her best friend.”

“Then, shall we give her another chance?”

Fei Youliang stepped down from the rim. His face slowly went blank; then his head tilted and he collapsed. Chen Ge arrived about four minutes later.

The camera had captured everything. Chen Ge’s first response was to administer first aid, and every viewer could see it.

“The boss didn’t do anything wrong. If anything, he was trying to save your friend.”

“We almost blamed an innocent person!”

Qin Guang’s employees had nothing left to say. By then, Chen Ge had retreated to the edge of the crowd and looked down at the black phone.

“Dear Specter’s Favored! Congratulations on triggering the Hidden Mission for the Two-Star Scenario Mu Yang High School: The Pen Spirit’s Wish!”
